summary: A screen that hides a reader's work also makes it harder for a librarian beside them to help.
realLife: The trial court recorded that restricted viewing angles made it hard for librarians or partners to see the same terminal screen alongside a patron.
inGame: needs: privacy screen and request for help.

turns.pulledBy: The reader wants help on a single step.
turns.what: The librarian asks the reader to describe the prompt.
turns.writesBack: The reader can remain at the private station.

turns.pulledBy: The work requires both people to see the page.
turns.what: The librarian offers another place to work together.
turns.writesBack: The reader chooses whether to move.
